title: ReSIDS trust-level observation
description: API 1.9.0, Disaster-FD -> agent. One Disaster-FD observation, published by the monitor colocated with a ReSIDS client after probing one of its targets (the aggregator or a ring neighbour). It maps one row of the Disaster-FD monitor CSV (Algorithm 1). trust_level is the monitor-wide value after this observation; the agent decides its learning mode from it (docs/TRUST_LEVEL.md). Disaster-FD supplies evidence, never a mode.

client.description: ReSIDS client the monitor is colocated with.

ts.description: Time the observation was made (CSV ts_arrival, microseconds since the epoch, as UTC ISO 8601).

impact_factor.description: 50 for the server, 15 for each ring peer in the pilot.

trusted.description: Target trusted after this observation (CSV trusted).

trust_level.description: Sum of the impact factors of the targets trusted after this observation (CSV trust_level).

threshold.description: Disaster-FD region threshold (30 in the pilot).

trusted_system.description: trust_level >= threshold. Not the same as federated: the agent applies its own bands.
